Very good grill. The only thing I don't like is the magnetic door that the propane tank sits behind.
It's a hassle opening and closing to turn on and shut off the gas. My old Weber had the tank on the outside of the unit, much easier access.

Results.Title: The Best Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this new grill. I have owned a Weber gas grill for over 20 years and finally decided to replace my old one with a new one. I have replaced flavor bars, grates and burners several times over the 20 years and the grill still functioned fine but was looking a bit worn, besides I would have had to replace the above mentioned part again and just felt it was time for a new one.  I love how the burners have been changed from side to side to now front to back.  I seem to be able to get a better cook using the indirect method than I used to.  The only drawback I have is with storing the tank inside the cabinet. I now dont have much room for my brushes and cooking utensils. I also like that the controls are on the front of the grill rather than on the side shelf which used to make that shelf unusable for other things.
Results.Title: Owned 1st Weber for 20 yrs. Expect same from new 1

Results.ReviewText: I grill 2-3 each week year around. I had my previous Weber for 17 years. It still worked great when I gave it to a young friend for his first Weber.
Results.Title: Quality from the ground up

Results.ReviewText: The picture in the instruction packet illustrating the back plate of the cabinet under the grill is slightly off and a little confusing.  In the picture the back plate is almost as large as the front door. But the piece provided was about half as tall. Minor enough it did not affect putting it together thankfully.
Results.Title: Instruction manual pics need updating

Results.ReviewText: Have had Webers for 40 years.  And they all are great.  The only issue with the Spirit model is the grease catch tray holder/frame.  The part that mounts to the grill wall underneath the grill.  This thing rusts out or decays very quickly compared the the rest of the grill witch is really poor.
Results.Title: Spirit is a great series but the ending sucks.

Results.ReviewText: This Weber Grill is the best. My husband loves the way it heats up and cooks the food.

Results.Title: Perfect grill

Results.Title: Family of 3

Results.ReviewText: Motor needs to be on RT. Or Lft. Not RT only Bracket is flimsy
Results.Title: There are two problems: bracket and motor placemen

Results.ReviewText: What a great grill - the quality is apparent from day 1. This is my first Weber gas grill purchase, and after many other gas grills that rust through in a year, are built with flimsy components, and don’t stand behind their products with a strong warranty, I am so happy to have my Weber that does all of that, and more.  The cooking surface is high quality, food never sticks to the grates. The box is heavy duty, no worries about rust through there. And the flame cooks very evenly, and the flavor vaporizers actually work to reduce flare ups and minimize cleaning. It’s a wonderful grill.
Results.Title: Highly recommended and totally worth it.

Results.ReviewText: I've enjoyed Weber grills for years and expect to continue using then. I reported earlier that I had a defect part.  Not true.  The grill I bought is perfect.
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: Best little grill. I replaced a larger Costco (Kirkland) grill that I had to return and get refunded because the "auto Ignition" didn't work correctly and the temperature rose slowly. This little Weber Grill works great. So happy I made the change.
Results.Title: Best Little Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill!  This the second Weber propane grill for us.  We wore the previous grill out
Results.Title: Propane Grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had other brands in the past…Nothing compares to my Weber. This is my 3rd (over 25 years).
Results.Title: Weber Rules

Results.ReviewText: We love our new Spirit E-310 gas grill. It light easily and cooks well. We used to have a Weber 315 limited edition grill. After about 10 years, it doors on the lower compartment corroded away and broke off. We live two blocks from the Atlantic Ocean. Everything corrodes here! That grill was family size and gave us great service. Now it is just my husband and I, the kids are married and on their own, so we downsized to the 310. It is roomy and when the kids and their families come over, it is still plenty big to grill for all of us. Same Weber quality you can count on.
Results.Title: Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this BBQ to replace an old Weber that was time to be retired. Seems like they have made several changes all of which are improvements, as one would expect. I have only used it once since I have only had it a month or so. This one is a 3 burner v my old 2 burner. Can definitely burn hot with all 3 burners on. Will take a few times to dial it in. I very much recommend it.
Results.Title: Sweet BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
These grills last 10 to 12 years and even longer 
If you keep them clean and take care of them. You can buy one of these and not worry about replacing or you can buy a 200 dollar grill and replace it every 2 years.
Results.Title: 4th Weber in last 50 years

Results.ReviewText: Works as it should for a new grille. Exact model was available for replacement purchase.

Results.UserNickname: Glad I Made It to Texas

Results.ReviewText: Great mid-range grill.  Produces a lot of heat and cooks steaks and burgers quickly and evenly.  It also is well built using much heavier gauge steel than other grills.  Finally, the drip pans are easily accessible for quick cleaning.  It's a bit more expensive than other grills, but the overall quality is worth the additional cost.
Results.Title: Reviewing Weber Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a good grill, my only concern is temperature control. It seems to burn a little too hot even with controls turned very low. I like the grates, easy to clean and hold the heat well.
Results.Title: Good Grill

Results.ReviewText: Overall it's a great grill. It was easy to assemble and the online tutorials for assembly were also really helpful. We've only had it for a few weeks and have used it a lot. It's a great grill and the food comes out great. The only observation I have for Weber to consider is that the handle on the far ends does get very hot when using so as long as you remember to open it using the middle part of the handle you should be fine, it's the ends where they curve back to the lid that get hot. But overall great barbecue and Weber lives up to its brand!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: The grill is missing the grease catcher tray. We've gone to the store where we purchased it. They sent us to Weber. We contacted Weber and were told the tray was on the way. When it arrived it was the wrong part. It is a disappointment when you purchase something brand new and it doesn't have all the parts even when it was already assembled. I wish we had received it in the box then we would hopefully had all the parts. Now it is a hassle.
Results.Title: missing grease catcher tray

Results.ReviewText:
best thing is ability to replace parts, i now have two one is 7 years old with key parts replaced.
The discouraging thing is the grate quality as well as grate being in two pieces. the two pieces create a big gap in grate where you lose pieces food down:) the two pieces of grill separate and create an even bigger gap. My original had a frying pan u could insert. that grill grate is much better designed.
I won't buy another 310 with the grate my new one has.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
